objects.name: Detection technique coverage: windows-wmic-cpu-discovery
objects.description: The following analytic detects the use of WMIC (Windows Management Instrumentation Command-line) for CPU discovery, often executed with commands such as “wmic cpu get name” This behavior is commonly associated with reconnaissance, where adversaries seek to gather details about system hardware, assess processing power, or determine if the environment is virtualized.
